prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore. A restored episode returns to the place it had, and later episodes move down one place. Non-members get 404. The delete toast on the Episodes page now has an Undo button, in both languages. I added toast action support to the toaster for this. All 9 backend tests pass and tsc is clean. I didn't run lint or try the UI in a browser. If other episodes were deleted or restored in between, an episode's saved place may no longer match its original neighbours. The restore then clamps to the end of the list, so Undo can land a few places off.

+def renumber_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID, insert_after: Optional[Episode] = None, new: Optional[Episode] = None, position: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
+    """Rewrites a project's live episodes as 1, 2, 3... (no commit).
+    If `new` is given it is placed right after `insert_after`, or at
+    1-based `position` (clamped to the end) when that is given."""
+    live = session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at)
+    ).all()
+    live = [e for e in live if new is None or e.id != new.id]
+    if new is not None and position is not None:
+        live.insert(max(0, min(position, len(live) + 1) - 1), new)
+    elif new is not None:
+        idx = next((i for i, e in enumerate(live) if insert_after is not None and e.id == insert_after.id), len(live) - 1)
+        live.insert(idx + 1, new)
+    for i, e in enumerate(live, start=1):
+        if e.episode_order != i:
+            e.episode_order = i
+            session.add(e)
+

+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _setup(client, h):
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    return pid
+
+
+def _seed(client, pid):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import Episode, StoryCut
+
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        ep = Episode(project_id=pid, title="Pilot", story_summary="sum", episode_order=1,
+                     character_outfits={"A": "coat"})
+        s.add(ep)
+        s.flush()
+        for i in (2, 1):
+            s.add(StoryCut(episode_id=ep.id, cut_order=i, script=f"s{i}", selected_layout="full",
+                           aspect_ratio="1:1", image_path=f"cuts/x/{i}.png", status="completed",
+                           dialogues=[{"speaker": "A", "text": f"t{i}"}],
+                           appearing_characters=[{"id": "1", "name": "A"}]))
+        s.commit()
+        return str(ep.id)
+
+
+def _cuts(eid):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import StoryCut
+
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        return s.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == eid).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)).all()
+
+
+def test_duplicate_copies_episode_and_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _setup(client, h)
+    eid = _seed(client, pid)
+    credits = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    new = r.json()
+    assert new["id"] != eid
+    assert new["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert new["title"] != "Pilot" and "Pilot" in new["title"]
+    assert new["story_summary"] == "sum"
+    assert new["character_outfits"] == {"A": "coat"}
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"] == credits
+
+    old_cuts, new_cuts = _cuts(eid), _cuts(new["id"])
+    assert [c.script for c in new_cuts] == ["s1", "s2"]
+    assert [c.id for c in new_cuts] != [c.id for c in old_cuts]
+    for a, b in zip(old_cuts, new_cuts):
+        assert (a.dialogues, a.appearing_characters, a.selected_layout, a.image_path) == (
+            b.dialogues, b.appearing_characters, b.selected_layout, b.image_path)
+
+    second = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert second["episode_order"] == 2
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={pid}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["episode_order"], e["id"]) for e in listed] == [(1, eid), (2, second["id"]), (3, new["id"])]
+
+
+def test_copy_is_independent(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _setup(client, h)
+    eid = _seed(client, pid)
+    new = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+
+    client.put(f"/api/v1/episodes/{new['id']}", headers=h, json={"title": "Take 2"})
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}", headers=h).json()["title"] == "Pilot"
+
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{new['id']}", headers=h).json()["title"] == "Take 2"
+    assert len(_cuts(new["id"])) == 2
+
+
+def test_non_members_get_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    eid = _seed(client, _setup(client, h))
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/duplicate", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post("/api/v1/episodes/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/duplicate", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/duplicate").status_code == 401
+
+
+def _add(client, h, pid, title):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": title, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 99})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _listing(client, h, pid):
+    return [(e["episode_order"], e["title"]) for e in client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={pid}", headers=h).json()]
+
+
+def test_copy_goes_after_original_and_delete_closes_gap(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _setup(client, h)
+    a, b, c = (_add(client, h, pid, t) for t in "ABC")
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid) == [(1, "A"), (2, "B"), (3, "C")]
+
+    copy = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{b}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert copy["episode_order"] == 3
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid) == [(1, "A"), (2, "B"), (3, "B (Copy)"), (4, "C")]
+
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid) == [(1, "B"), (2, "B (Copy)"), (3, "C")]
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{c}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid) == [(1, "B"), (2, "B (Copy)")]
+    assert _add(client, h, pid, "D")
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid)[-1] == (3, "D")
+
+
+def test_restore_puts_episode_back_with_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _setup(client, h)
+    eid = _seed(client, pid)  # "Pilot" with two cuts, order 1
+    a, b, c = (_add(client, h, pid, t) for t in "ABC")
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{b}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid) == [(1, "Pilot"), (2, "A"), (3, "C")]
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{b}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 3
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid) == [(1, "Pilot"), (2, "A"), (3, "B"), (4, "C")]
+
+    # deleted episode keeps its cuts and gets them back
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid) == [(1, "A"), (2, "B"), (3, "C")]
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/restore", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert _listing(client, h, pid)[0] == (1, "Pilot")
+    assert len(_cuts(eid)) == 2
+    # restoring a live episode is harmless
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/restore", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert [o for o, _ in _listing(client, h, pid)] == list(range(1, 5))
+
+
+def test_restore_non_members_get_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    a = _add(client, h, _setup(client, h), "A")
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}", headers=h)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}/restore", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}/restore").status_code == 401
+    assert client.post("/api/v1/episodes/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/restore", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{a}", headers=h).status_code == 404  # still deleted
